global.titleZh: 庭审获悉：博·拉马尔-康登称曾被自然疗法师诊断出癌症，但记不清具体信息
global.summaryZh: 前警官博·拉马尔-康登在法庭上声称自己曾被自然疗法师诊断出癌症，并曾以此为由向杰西·贝尔德发送信息。然而，他在接受质询时无法提供该疗法师的姓名或诊所地址。

global.summary: A 17-year-old boy with autism was found alive on Thursday after six days lost in eastern Australian woodlands. The boy, whom police identified only as William, had begun camping with a teenage friend when he disappeared last Friday near Walhalla, a former gold-mining town 185km east of Melbourne, police said. global.titleZh: 在澳大利亚丛林失踪6天的自闭症少年获救
global.summaryZh: 一名17岁的自闭症少年在澳大利亚东部丛林失踪6天后，于周四被警方直升机发现并获救。该少年目前身体状况良好，已与家人团聚。
global.whyImportant: 这起搜救行动的成功引发了社会对失踪人员搜救工作的广泛关注。

global.title: Is the US blue wave a turning point for Europe, too?
global.summary: Far-right populists remain insurgent and pro-EU governments are braced for Trump’s betrayal. But the midterms also showed that democracy can fight back • Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox? Sign up here “Is Maga dead?” asked Margaret, a Guardian reader in Switzerland, in a live Q&A with our correspondents after the seismic US midterm elections. If Margaret’s query expressed a hope that the Democrats’ blue wave could transform Europe’s fortunes after two years of Maga-induced trauma, she was probably not alone. The resounding defeat for Donald Trump’s Republicans and the installation of a Democratic-controlled US Congress has been met with understandable relief in European capitals. In the short term however, the worst for Europe is not over. Trump didn’t need congressional approval, after all, to unleash a trade war on his supposed European allies, threaten to invade Greenland, try to stitch up Ukraine or go to war with Iran, an act that has inflated fuel and food prices disastrously. global.titleZh: 美国“蓝色浪潮”是否也是欧洲的转折点？
global.summaryZh: 美国中期选举中民主党的胜利让欧洲政界感到宽慰，但欧洲仍面临极右翼民粹主义和特朗普政策带来的长期不确定性。尽管短期内局势有所缓和，但欧洲在贸易和地缘政治方面仍需保持警惕。
global.whyImportant: 分析探讨了美国政治变动对欧洲地缘政治及政策走向的潜在影响。

global.titleZh: 中国步兵部队如何训练以在无人机密集的战场上生存？
global.summaryZh: 面对无人机威胁的日益增长，中国人民解放军步兵部队正通过引入强制性反无人机训练、新装备及新战术来提升生存能力。演习表明，传统的伪装手段已不足以应对无人机引导的精确打击。
global.whyImportant: 反映了现代战争中无人机技术对传统步兵战术带来的深刻变革。

global.summary: Workplace relations minister Amanda Rishworth launches best practice guide on AI adoption after Qantas and Canva job cuts Entry-level jobs will be the first to be automated due to AI, but it could mean fewer hours and higher wages for ordinary workers – or make jobs tougher with more burnout and workplace surveillance - the government has warned employers. global.titleZh: 香港通过法案以加速“北部都会区”大型项目开发

global.whyImportant: 该法案的通过为香港北部都会区的建设提供了法律保障，将直接影响香港未来的土地供应与区域经济整合。

china.title: Thursday briefing: What we do (and don’t) know about Alice Huang and the Nvidia affair
china.summary: In today’s newsletter: US intelligence reportedly believes the former tech executive was recruited by Beijing, raising questions about the security of the AI industry and Trump’s close ties to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang Good morning. Espionage is supposed to be a secretive business, and spies are supposed to be virtually invisible. That hasn’t been the case for Alice Huang, the mysterious Shanghai executive who formed a romantic relationship with Jensen Huang, the founder of Nvidia, one of America’s most powerful tech companies. Many questions have arisen since it emerged that US intelligence believes that Huang (no relation of Jensen’s) is an asset recruited by the Chinese intelligence services to spy on behalf of Beijing. This morning’s newsletter explains what we know about the story, and what it tells us about the effectiveness of Chinese espionage. That’s after the headlines. china.summaryZh: 中国人民银行在最新季度货币政策执行报告中删除了关于额外政策措施的表述，分析师认为这表明北京的重心已转向落实现有支持政策。市场普遍预期12月的年度政策会议将成为观察后续刺激计划的窗口。

china.title: Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang as stock price plunges
china.summary: The meeting comes after the executive and co-founder admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy Nvidia’s board of directors met on Wednesday to decide whether to oust Jensen Huang as CEO of the world’s most valuable chip company, according to multiple reports, after a tumultuous week in which the executive and co-founder of the company admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. The meeting marks ⁠a sharp shift from Sunday, when Nvidia’s board ​expressed confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and the company’s stock slid more than 8% in after-hours trading after the Wall Street Journal reported that ⁠the company was preparing to fire Huang. china.whyImportant: 作为全球市值最高的芯片公司，其领导层的动荡可能引发全球科技市场及供应链的剧烈波动。

china.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过改善资本配置效率，增强中国资本市场对投资者的吸引力。

china.summaryZh: 深圳20岁的罗女士在刷短视频时，其表亲发现一名长相极其相似的夏姓女子，两人随后取得联系并确认了身份。她们相信彼此是20年前出生时失散的同卵双胞胎。
china.whyImportant: 这一罕见的寻亲案例引发了公众对个人身份认同及社交媒体在社会连接中作用的广泛讨论。

usa.titleZh: 拜登称若早知患癌就不会寻求连任

usa.title: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies
usa.summary: Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday. The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century. One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities. Continue reading...

usa.whyImportant: 此事件反映了学术界对历史殖民与种族主义研究的反思，以及对被奴役者尊严的修复。

watch.whyImportant: 针对医疗设施的袭击引发了国际社会对平民保护和人道主义危机的广泛关注。

watch.title: Silk Road in orbit: China to build 20-satellite ‘space AI’ system for Oman
watch.summary: Hangzhou-based Star Vision will build Oman a network of 20 satellites that use AI to process images in orbit and spot ships and floods in real time, in what the company called China’s most valuable commercial space contract ever. The deal – worth over US$200 million according to the start-up – was signed in Beijing last week with Omani firm Oman Lens during a landmark state visit by the country’s ruler, Sultan Haitham bin Tariq. Besides the constellation, the package includes a satellite...
watch.titleZh: 轨道上的丝绸之路：中国将为阿曼建造20颗卫星的“空间人工智能”系统
watch.summaryZh: 杭州星视科技公司将为阿曼建造一个由20颗卫星组成的网络，利用人工智能在轨道上实时处理图像并监测船只与洪水。这是中国目前价值最高的商业航天合同，总额超过2亿美元。
watch.whyImportant: 该项目展示了中国在商业航天领域的出口能力，并深化了中国与阿曼在科技基础设施方面的合作。

watch.titleZh: 悉尼丛林中沙发内发现人体躯干，引发凶杀案调查
watch.summaryZh: 警方在接到公众关于异味的报告后，在悉尼北部的丛林中发现了一个装有人体躯干的沙发。目前警方已展开凶杀案调查，并正在对现场进行搜查。
watch.whyImportant: 这一骇人听闻的发现引发了当地社区的恐慌，并促使警方启动大规模刑事调查以查明死者身份。

items.title: 美期中選舉台灣連線大換血 外交部 ： 跨黨派友台共識仍在 - 政治
items.titleZh: 美期中选举台湾连线大换血 外交部：跨党派友台共识仍在
items.summaryZh: 美国中期选举导致国会“台湾连线”成员发生变动。台湾外交部表示，尽管人员更迭，但美国国会支持台湾的跨党派共识依然稳固。
items.whyImportant: 此表态旨在强调台湾与美国国会关系的持续稳定性。

items.title: Teenager in critical condition after likely ‘train surfing’ on Sydney Harbour Bridge, police say
items.summary: ‘You just don’t mess or play with a 400-tonne train’, Sydney Trains says as 17-year-old suffers multiple injuries to head, chest and pelvis Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A 17-year-old boy is in a critical condition after falling from the outside of a train on the Sydney Harbour Bridge while he was likely train surfing, NSW police say. Around 11.30am on Thursday, emergency services were called to the railway corridor between Wynyard and Milsons Point train stations following reports someone had fallen from a northbound Tangara train onto the tracks on the bridge. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 悉尼海港大桥发生疑似“火车冲浪”事故，一名青少年伤势危急
items.summaryZh: 一名17岁少年在悉尼海港大桥上疑似进行“火车冲浪”时从行驶的列车外侧坠落。目前该少年头部、胸部及骨盆多处受伤，情况危急。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了公众对青少年危险行为及铁路安全监管的关注。

items.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon says he was diagnosed with cancer by naturopath but doesn’t recall which one, trial hears
items.summary: Former police officer questioned about Instagram message he asked friend to send to Jessie Baird referencing ‘cancerous tumour’ Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon has claimed in court that he was diagnosed with cancer by a naturopath and has been questioned about a post-breakup message to Jesse Baird where he referred to the diagnosis. But Lamarre-Condon on Thursday told the court he could not name the naturopath or the location of their practice, claiming there had been new developments and stores had been “cleared out”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 庭审获悉：博·拉马尔-康登称曾被自然疗法师诊断出癌症，但记不清具体信息
items.summaryZh: 前警官博·拉马尔-康登在法庭上声称自己曾被自然疗法师诊断出癌症，并曾以此为由向杰西·贝尔德发送信息。然而，他在接受质询时无法提供该疗法师的姓名或诊所地址。
items.whyImportant: 被告关于癌症诊断的说法在法庭上受到质疑，影响了案件的审理过程。

items.title: Autistic teen missing in Australian bushland for 6 days rescued alive
items.summary: A 17-year-old boy with autism was found alive on Thursday after six days lost in eastern Australian woodlands. The boy, whom police identified only as William, had begun camping with a teenage friend when he disappeared last Friday near Walhalla, a former gold-mining town 185km east of Melbourne, police said. A police helicopter crew found him surrounded by wilderness lying in a dry creek bed, and he was later reunited with his mother. William was in good spirits and mostly in good health, the...
items.titleZh: 在澳大利亚丛林失踪6天的自闭症少年获救
items.summaryZh: 一名17岁的自闭症少年在澳大利亚东部丛林失踪6天后，于周四被警方直升机发现并获救。该少年目前身体状况良好，已与家人团聚。
items.whyImportant: 这起搜救行动的成功引发了社会对失踪人员搜救工作的广泛关注。

items.title: Is the US blue wave a turning point for Europe, too?
items.summary: Far-right populists remain insurgent and pro-EU governments are braced for Trump’s betrayal. But the midterms also showed that democracy can fight back • Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox? Sign up here “Is Maga dead?” asked Margaret, a Guardian reader in Switzerland, in a live Q&A with our correspondents after the seismic US midterm elections. If Margaret’s query expressed a hope that the Democrats’ blue wave could transform Europe’s fortunes after two years of Maga-induced trauma, she was probably not alone. The resounding defeat for Donald Trump’s Republicans and the installation of a Democratic-controlled US Congress has been met with understandable relief in European capitals. In the short term however, the worst for Europe is not over. Trump didn’t need congressional approval, after all, to unleash a trade war on his supposed European allies, threaten to invade Greenland, try to stitch up Ukraine or go to war with Iran, an act that has inflated fuel and food prices disastrously. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国“蓝色浪潮”是否也是欧洲的转折点？
items.summaryZh: 美国中期选举中民主党的胜利让欧洲政界感到宽慰，但欧洲仍面临极右翼民粹主义和特朗普政策带来的长期不确定性。尽管短期内局势有所缓和，但欧洲在贸易和地缘政治方面仍需保持警惕。
items.whyImportant: 分析探讨了美国政治变动对欧洲地缘政治及政策走向的潜在影响。

items.title: How are Chinese infantry units training to survive drone-filled battlefields?
items.summary: China’s infantry units are adapting to the growing threat from drones, with some brigades introducing compulsory counter-drone training, new equipment and fresh tactics to help soldiers evade aerial surveillance and attacks. The latest example comes from a brigade of the People’s Liberation Army’s (PLA) 75th Group Army, which has made counter-drone training compulsory after an exercise exposed how troops relying on traditional camouflage were vulnerable to drone-directed artillery...
items.titleZh: 中国步兵部队如何训练以在无人机密集的战场上生存？
items.summaryZh: 面对无人机威胁的日益增长，中国人民解放军步兵部队正通过引入强制性反无人机训练、新装备及新战术来提升生存能力。演习表明，传统的伪装手段已不足以应对无人机引导的精确打击。
items.whyImportant: 反映了现代战争中无人机技术对传统步兵战术带来的深刻变革。

items.title: Hegseth entourage reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
items.summary: A soldier guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier issued a verbal reprimand to a group of advisers and staffers with US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth following a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery. Video shows Hegseth taking photos on the empty steps in front of the tomb with his wife, Jennifer, chief of staff Ricky Buria, deputy chief of staff Patrick Weaver and senior adviser Tami Radabaugh. As the group broke from taking photos, a loud laugh could be heard, and the soldier...
items.titleZh: 赫格塞斯随行人员在无名烈士墓前遭卫兵训斥
items.summaryZh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯及其随行人员在阿灵顿国家公墓参加退伍军人节仪式后，因在无名烈士墓前拍照并发出笑声，遭到了守卫士兵的口头训斥。
items.whyImportant: 该事件因涉及对国家纪念场所的不当行为而引发了舆论争议。

items.title: Fewer hours and higher wages – or more burnout and surveillance: employers told to prepare for AI
items.summary: Workplace relations minister Amanda Rishworth launches best practice guide on AI adoption after Qantas and Canva job cuts Entry-level jobs will be the first to be automated due to AI, but it could mean fewer hours and higher wages for ordinary workers – or make jobs tougher with more burnout and workplace surveillance - the government has warned employers. While major companies like Qantas and Canva slash their workforces in restructures spurred by AI changes, workplace relations minister Amanda Rishworth said employers must give workers “a clear plan” about how automation could affect their jobs, and the opportunity to move into new roles. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 工作时间减少、工资提高，还是倦怠与监控增加？雇主被要求为人工智能做好准备
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚政府发布了人工智能应用最佳实践指南，警告雇主自动化可能导致入门级岗位减少。政府强调，企业必须为员工提供明确的转型计划，以应对AI带来的工作性质变化。
items.whyImportant: 突显了人工智能在职场应用中对劳动力市场及员工权益带来的挑战。

items.title: Nexperia’s China unit claims supply chain ‘localisation’ as rift with Dutch parent deepens
items.summary: Nexperia’s Chinese unit says its domestic 12-inch wafer platform now covers all of its product categories, marking a key milestone in building an independent supply chain more than a year after its Dutch parent halted direct shipments of European wafers. items.titleZh: 安世半导体中国部门深化与荷兰母公司裂痕，声称实现供应链“本土化”
items.summaryZh: 安世半导体中国公司宣布其12英寸晶圆平台已覆盖所有产品类别，标志着在荷兰母公司停止直接供应欧洲晶圆一年多后，其独立供应链建设取得关键进展。公司首席执行官张志强表示，中国部门已通过与本土代工厂合作及利用自有设施，实现了生产自主化。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了在国际贸易限制背景下，跨国企业中国分支机构为保障供应链安全而加速本土化转型的趋势。

items.title: Hong Kong passes bill to speed up development of Northern Metropolis megaproject
items.summary: Hong Kong’s legislature has given the green light to legislation aimed at expediting the development of the Northern Metropolis megaproject near the border with mainland China, with the government saying the bill will help achieve targets in the city’s first five-year plan. Lawmakers completed the third reading of the Northern Metropolis Development Bill and unanimously passed it on Thursday. The bill resumed a second reading on Wednesday, with lawmakers debating it for about eight hours over...
items.titleZh: 香港通过法案以加速“北部都会区”大型项目开发
items.summaryZh: 香港立法会已通过《北部都会区发展条例草案》，旨在加快这一靠近内地边境的大型开发项目进程。政府表示，该法案将有助于实现城市首个五年计划中的相关发展目标。
items.whyImportant: 该法案的通过为香港北部都会区的建设提供了法律保障，将直接影响香港未来的土地供应与区域经济整合。

items.title: Thursday briefing: What we do (and don’t) know about Alice Huang and the Nvidia affair
items.summary: In today’s newsletter: US intelligence reportedly believes the former tech executive was recruited by Beijing, raising questions about the security of the AI industry and Trump’s close ties to Nvidia chief Jensen Huang Good morning. Espionage is supposed to be a secretive business, and spies are supposed to be virtually invisible. That hasn’t been the case for Alice Huang, the mysterious Shanghai executive who formed a romantic relationship with Jensen Huang, the founder of Nvidia, one of America’s most powerful tech companies. Many questions have arisen since it emerged that US intelligence believes that Huang (no relation of Jensen’s) is an asset recruited by the Chinese intelligence services to spy on behalf of Beijing. This morning’s newsletter explains what we know about the story, and what it tells us about the effectiveness of Chinese espionage. That’s after the headlines. items.titleZh: 周四简报：关于爱丽丝·黄与英伟达事件的已知与未知
items.summaryZh: 美国情报部门据称认为前科技高管爱丽丝·黄已被北京招募，引发了对人工智能行业安全及特朗普与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋关系的担忧。爱丽丝·黄与黄仁勋曾有恋爱关系，目前外界正密切关注此案对英伟达及美国科技安全的影响。
items.whyImportant: 此事件涉及地缘政治背景下的商业间谍指控，可能对全球半导体行业领军企业的领导层及安全评估产生深远影响。

items.title: China signals focus shift to policy delivery as PBOC drops stimulus language: analysts
items.summary: China’s central bank’s decision to drop a reference to additional policy measures from its latest quarterly report suggests Beijing’s focus is shifting towards implementing existing support measures, analysts said, pointing to December’s annual policy-setting meeting as the next window for fresh stimulus. In its third-quarter monetary policy implementation report released on Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) removed a pledge included in its previous quarterly report to “timely plan...
items.titleZh: 分析师：中国央行删除刺激性措辞，政策重心转向落实
items.summaryZh: 中国人民银行在最新季度货币政策执行报告中删除了关于额外政策措施的表述，分析师认为这表明北京的重心已转向落实现有支持政策。市场普遍预期12月的年度政策会议将成为观察后续刺激计划的窗口。
items.whyImportant: 政策措辞的调整暗示中国政府目前更倾向于观察现有政策的实施效果，而非立即推出大规模增量刺激。

items.title: Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang as stock price plunges
items.summary: The meeting comes after the executive and co-founder admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy Nvidia’s board of directors met on Wednesday to decide whether to oust Jensen Huang as CEO of the world’s most valuable chip company, according to multiple reports, after a tumultuous week in which the executive and co-founder of the company admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. The meeting marks ⁠a sharp shift from Sunday, when Nvidia’s board ​expressed confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and the company’s stock slid more than 8% in after-hours trading after the Wall Street Journal reported that ⁠the company was preparing to fire Huang. items.titleZh: 据报道，英伟达董事会正决定是否罢免首席执行官黄仁勋，股价随之下跌
items.summaryZh: 在英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋承认与一名被指控为中国间谍的女性存在恋爱关系后，公司董事会于周三召开会议讨论其去留问题。此前有报道称公司正准备罢免黄仁勋，导致英伟达股价在盘后交易中大幅下跌。
items.whyImportant: 作为全球市值最高的芯片公司，其领导层的动荡可能引发全球科技市场及供应链的剧烈波动。

items.title: As Beijing pushes for cash return, Chinese firms can unlock 15% valuation boost: report
items.summary: Chinese companies could unlock a further 15 per cent in equity valuation upside by stepping up share buy-backs and dividend payouts, as Beijing seeks to encourage listed firms to return more cash to investors, according to Goldman Sachs. The US investment bank said in a report on Wednesday that an increase in corporate payout ratios and share repurchases, in line with policymakers’ efforts to improve shareholder returns, could lift valuations of the MSCI China Index by about 15 per cent from...
items.titleZh: 报告：随着北京推动现金回报，中国企业可解锁15%的估值增长
items.summaryZh: 高盛在报告中指出，随着北京鼓励上市公司增加股东回报，中国企业若能加大股票回购和分红力度，有望提升估值。预计提高派息率和回购规模可使MSCI中国指数的估值提升约15%。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在通过改善资本配置效率，增强中国资本市场对投资者的吸引力。

items.title: Chinese women believe they are long-lost twins after chance sighting in short video
items.summary: A chance discovery on a short-video-sharing platform reunited two Chinese women who believe they are twins separated at birth 20 years ago. Recently, 20-year-old Shenzhen resident Luo posted a video documenting her reunion with a woman she believed to be her identical twin sister, a sibling she never knew she had. While scrolling through Douyin, Luo’s cousin came across an account belonging to a woman surnamed Xia whose face bore a striking resemblance to Luo’s. Stunned by the similarity, the...
items.titleZh: 中国两名女子在短视频平台偶遇，确信是失散多年的双胞胎
items.summaryZh: 深圳20岁的罗女士在刷短视频时，其表亲发现一名长相极其相似的夏姓女子，两人随后取得联系并确认了身份。她们相信彼此是20年前出生时失散的同卵双胞胎。
items.whyImportant: 这一罕见的寻亲案例引发了公众对个人身份认同及社交媒体在社会连接中作用的广泛讨论。

items.title: Biden says he would not have run again had he known of cancer
items.summary: Joe Biden says he did not know he had cancer while he was US president and would not have sought a second term if he already had been diagnosed. The former Democratic president’s comments came in an interview with People magazine before the release of his White House memoir on Tuesday. “If I had known that I was feeling lousy because I had cancer,” said Biden, who turns 84 on November 20, “I would’ve not gone forward” with a 2024 re-election bid that ended after a disastrous debate performance...
items.titleZh: 拜登称若早知患癌就不会寻求连任
items.summaryZh: 前美国总统拜登在接受采访时表示，如果他当时知道自己身体不适是因为患有癌症，就不会参加2024年的总统竞选。他在卸任后出版的回忆录中披露了这一健康状况。
items.whyImportant: 这一披露解释了拜登在竞选期间表现不佳的部分原因，并引发了关于政治人物健康透明度的讨论。

items.title: Presidential Message on Victory Day for World War I
items.summary: On November 11, 1918, after more than four grueling years, an armistice at last silenced the guns of the First World War. With enduring pride, we celebrate America’s pivotal role in winning this global conflict. items.titleZh: 总统关于第一次世界大战胜利日的致辞
items.summaryZh: 1918年11月11日，历经四年多的残酷战争后，停战协议终于让第一次世界大战的炮火平息。美国政府通过致辞纪念美国在赢得这场全球冲突中所发挥的关键作用，并向参战英雄致敬。
items.whyImportant: 此举旨在重申美国在历史性全球冲突中的贡献，并借此纪念日强化国家认同与爱国主义精神。

items.title: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida
items.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
items.titleZh: 著名邮轮“美国号”在佛罗里达海岸沉没
items.summaryZh: 尽管活动人士曾努力争取将其保留并改建为博物馆，但该历史悠久的邮轮最终未能幸免。它现在将被沉入海底，成为世界上最大的人造海洋礁石。
items.whyImportant: 这标志着一艘具有历史意义的邮轮正式退役，并转变为海洋生态保护设施。

items.title: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies
items.summary: Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday. The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century. One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 两具曾被哈佛大学用于优生学研究的被奴役者遗骸被送回巴西
items.summaryZh: 两具被认为属于非洲或非裔巴西人的头骨遗骸已从美国遣返回巴西。这些遗骸在19世纪被带走，并曾被哈佛大学用于种族主义优生学研究，现已在巴西举行仪式迎接归国。
items.whyImportant: 此事件反映了学术界对历史殖民与种族主义研究的反思，以及对被奴役者尊严的修复。

items.title: “We Render You the Highest Salute”: President Trump Honors America’s Veterans on Hallowed Ground at Arlington
items.summary: On this Veterans Day, President Donald J. Trump stood among the fallen at Arlington National Cemetery and rendered our nation’s highest salute to the living who still carry the cost of freedom. In words that echoed across the quiet hills where generations of heroes rest, the Commander-in-Chief honored every Patriot who has worn the uniform […] The post “We Render You the Highest Salute”: President Trump Honors America’s Veterans on Hallowed Ground at Arlington appeared first on The White House.
items.titleZh: “我们向你们致以最高敬礼”：特朗普总统在阿灵顿国家公墓向美国退伍军人致敬
items.summaryZh: 在退伍军人节当天，特朗普总统在阿灵顿国家公墓向阵亡将士及退伍军人致敬。他发表讲话赞扬了所有曾身着军装的爱国者，并向那些为自由付出代价的人们表达了敬意。
items.whyImportant: 总统通过此举强调了对军人贡献的认可，并借此巩固与退伍军人群体的政治联系。

items.title: Israeli strike on hospital kills at least five Palestinians, Gaza civil defence agency says
items.summary: The strike hit the surgery department of Nasser Hospital, injuring at least 20 people and causing extensive damage, a spokesperson says.
items.titleZh: 加沙民防机构称以色列袭击医院导致至少五名巴勒斯坦人死亡
items.summaryZh: 据发言人称，此次袭击击中了纳赛尔医院的外科部门，造成至少20人受伤并导致设施严重受损。该事件进一步加剧了当地医疗机构面临的严峻安全挑战。
items.whyImportant: 针对医疗设施的袭击引发了国际社会对平民保护和人道主义危机的广泛关注。

items.title: Silk Road in orbit: China to build 20-satellite ‘space AI’ system for Oman
items.summary: Hangzhou-based Star Vision will build Oman a network of 20 satellites that use AI to process images in orbit and spot ships and floods in real time, in what the company called China’s most valuable commercial space contract ever. The deal – worth over US$200 million according to the start-up – was signed in Beijing last week with Omani firm Oman Lens during a landmark state visit by the country’s ruler, Sultan Haitham bin Tariq. items.titleZh: 轨道上的丝绸之路：中国将为阿曼建造20颗卫星的“空间人工智能”系统
items.summaryZh: 杭州星视科技公司将为阿曼建造一个由20颗卫星组成的网络，利用人工智能在轨道上实时处理图像并监测船只与洪水。这是中国目前价值最高的商业航天合同，总额超过2亿美元。
items.whyImportant: 该项目展示了中国在商业航天领域的出口能力，并深化了中国与阿曼在科技基础设施方面的合作。

items.titleZh: 悉尼丛林中沙发内发现人体躯干，引发凶杀案调查
items.summaryZh: 警方在接到公众关于异味的报告后，在悉尼北部的丛林中发现了一个装有人体躯干的沙发。目前警方已展开凶杀案调查，并正在对现场进行搜查。
items.whyImportant: 这一骇人听闻的发现引发了当地社区的恐慌，并促使警方启动大规模刑事调查以查明死者身份。
